title: Hello Function
prompt:
Write two functions in `solution.py`:

**Requirements:**
1. `greet(name)` -- takes a string `name` and returns `"Hello, {name}!"` using an f-string
2. `greet_many(names)` -- takes a list of names, calls `greet` for each one, and returns all greetings joined by newlines (`"\n"`)

**Examples:**
```python
greet("Alice")         # "Hello, Alice!"
greet_many(["A", "B"]) # "Hello, A!\nHello, B!"
greet_many([])          # ""
```
hints: str.join() combines a list of strings with a separator
A generator expression inside join() avoids creating an intermediate list

solution.py.name: greet
solution.py.description: Define a greet function that accepts a name parameter

solution.py.name: greet_many
solution.py.description: Define a greet_many function that accepts a names parameter
Use an f-string to format the greeting
solution.py.hint: Use f"Hello, {name}!" to interpolate the name
